exposure: COVID-19 infection during the peripartum period
cohort: The study included 22,911 women who had singleton vaginal deliveries and cesarean deliveries due to failed vacuum extraction between June 2020 and January 2022 at a large tertiary medical center.
finding: Peripartum infection with COVID-19 was independently associated with a significantly increased risk (more than fourfold) for obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASIS).
